ambiguities_or_notes: остался бы верно к вечеру доволен собою is rendered ‘by evening would probably have remained satisfied with myself,’ preserving the source's self-assessment rather than smoothing it away.
The repeated я сам лишил себя ... довольным собою remains ‘I myself deprived myself ... of being satisfied with myself.’
The deleted fragment прие is represented as the corresponding English fragment ‘arri’ rather than expanded silently to a complete word.
